A1.label: ATK bonus from Coil
A1.reason: Her Skill's bomblets give her Coil, which raises her ATK by 16% for 10 seconds, the time she spends on Normal Attacks after it.

A4.label: Rushing Ice, full Cryo bonus
A4.reason: The Cryo bonus grows by 3.5% a second during Rushing Ice and reaches its full size only at the end.

coil.label: Rushing Ice
coil.reason: Four Coil stacks from her Skill's bomblets put her in Rushing Ice, the state in which she deals her Normal Attacks.
